1 week (one mission per day, 30–60 min each)

{npc:Rashid}, the travelling merchant, is looking for experienced traders to buy goods from. To prove you are worthy, you do one task per day for a whole week, from Monday to Sunday, in different cities. At the end you can sell him items on any day and you get the achievement Recognised Trader.
Rashid is looking for experienced traders so that he can buy goods from them. You have to pass a test to prove you are a worthy trader: a new task each day, for a whole week.
You have to start on a **Monday** (after server save).
You can only do one mission per day: after each mission, wait for the next server save.
600 oz of free capacity on Tuesday to carry the {item:Heavy Package}.
1500 gp (100 cheese + 1000 vase + 250 sword + margin) plus money for travel
Saturday, only if you are the one catching the goldfish (Sunken Quarter or Calassa)
You can now sell items to {npc:Rashid} on any day
Achievement **Just in Time** (Wednesday), if you have already done the Ice Delivery mission of {wiki:The Explorer Society Quest}
On Sunday, in Carlin, after all the week's tasks: {npc:Rashid} declares you a Recognised Trader.
Prepare the items beforehand: the {item:Deer Trophy}, the 3 {item:Iron Ore|Iron Ores} and the {item:Goldfish Bowl} can be obtained in advance and handed in on the right day.
Rashid changes city every day. This is the order: Monday Svargrond, Tuesday Liberty Bay, Wednesday Port Hope, Thursday Ankrahmun, Friday Darashia, Saturday Edron, Sunday Carlin.
Go to {npc:Dankwart}'s tavern in **Svargrond**, where Rashid is on Mondays. Say {key:hi}, {key:mission}, {key:yes} and {key:yes} again. He asks you for a {item:Deer Trophy}.
With the {item:Deer Trophy} in your inventory, tell Rashid {key:mission} and {key:yes}. The quest log updates.
While looking for the Deer Trophy, the danger noted for this day is the {creature:Smuggler|Smugglers}.
On Tuesdays Rashid is in {npc:Lyonel}'s tavern in **Liberty Bay**. Say {key:hi}, {key:mission}, {key:yes}, {key:yes}. He sends you to fetch a package from {npc:Willard}, in Edron.

Travel to **Edron** and look for {npc:Willard}, the weapons seller. Say {key:hi}, {key:package for Rashid} and {key:yes} (you promise not to tell Rashid). He sends you to the Outlaw Camp to talk to {npc:Snake Eye}.

Go to the {wiki:Outlaw Camp} and talk to {npc:Snake Eye}: {key:hi}, {key:package for Rashid}. He lets you open the {item:Door (Sealed)|flashing door}. The Outlaw Camp is between **Thais** and **Venore**, west of the {wiki:Plains of Havoc}: follow the road to the camp ({coord:32643,32222,7}). Snake Eye is in the tavern, on the **underground** floor of the main building.
On the way and in the Outlaw Camp there are {creature:Smuggler|Smugglers}, {creature:Wild Warrior|Wild Warriors}, {creature:Bandit|Bandits} and sometimes lured {creature:Minotaur|Minotaurs}.
Pass the door and take the {item:Heavy Package} from the crate. You need **600 oz** of free capacity.

Go back to Rashid in **Liberty Bay** (still on Tuesday) and say {key:mission}, {key:yes}. To get there, go up from the tavern to the surface and walk to **Venore** (east) or **Thais** (west); there take the boat to **Liberty Bay** ({key:hi}, {key:liberty bay}, {key:yes}).
On Wednesdays Rashid is in {npc:Clyde}'s tavern in **Port Hope**. Say {key:hi}, {key:mission}, {key:yes}, {key:yes}. He asks you for a {item:Scarab Cheese} from {npc:Miraia}, in Darashia.
Talk to Rashid **first**. If you buy the cheese before asking for the mission, he does not accept it.
Travel to **Darashia** and tell {npc:Miraia}: {key:hi}, {key:scarab cheese}, {key:yes}. It costs 100 gp.
Carrying the cheese on foot to Port Hope

You have **30 minutes**: after that the cheese turns into a {item:Mouldy Cheese}. **You cannot use boats**: walk to Port Hope, following the {wiki:Route:Ankrahmun to Port Hope|route from Ankrahmun to Port Hope}. On the way there are {creature:Nomad (Basic)|Nomads} and creatures from {wiki:Tiquanda}. The next steps describe the route.

Rashid **does not accept** the cheese if: you bought it before talking to him; you sent it by parcel; you used a {item:Temple Teleport Scroll} to get to Port Hope. Also be careful: the cheese is edible, so do not eat it by mistake. If you lose it, buy another from Miraia.

Leave Darashia and cross the continent of Darama to **Ankrahmun**, following the maps in order: you pass the Devourer, the north pass of Kha'zeel and the Kha'labal desert. The route is almost all flat desert, with no obstacles. You may meet {creature:Sandcrawler|Sandcrawlers}, {creature:Hyaena|Hyaenas}, {creature:Nomad (Basic)|Nomads}, {creature:Scorpion|Scorpions} and, in raids, {creature:Scarab|Scarabs} and {creature:Larva|Larvas}.
From Ankrahmun to Port Hope: the mountains

From Ankrahmun, climb the mountains to the **west** ({wiki:Kha'zeel Pass|Kha'zeel Pass}; there are {creature:Hyaena|Hyaenas}). At the top cross the bridge (1 {creature:Nomad (Basic)|Nomad} and a few {creature:Bandit|Bandits}) and then go down, with no monsters, until you reach a staircase.
From Ankrahmun to Port Hope: the jungle

Now the most dangerous part: the {wiki:Tiquanda} jungle to **Port Hope**, to the west. Going straight usually takes longer because of the plants, trees and creatures in the way: follow the route on the maps, which goes around the densest parts. The further **south**, the easier and safer the terrain.

You may meet {creature:Spider|Spiders}, {creature:Poison Spider|Poison Spiders}, {creature:Tarantula|Tarantulas}, {creature:Centipede|Centipedes}, {creature:Wasp|Wasps}, {creature:Crocodile|Crocodiles}, {creature:Spit Nettle|Spit Nettles}, Dworcs, {creature:Elephant|Elephants}, {creature:Terror Bird|Terror Birds}, {creature:Carniphila|Carniphilas} and even {creature:Hydra|Hydras} lured by other players.
Achievement **Just in Time**, if you have already done the Ice Delivery mission of The Explorer Society Quest

On Thursdays Rashid is in **Ankrahmun**, in {npc:Arito}'s tavern, one floor above the post office. Say {key:hi}, {key:mission}, {key:yes}, {key:yes}. He asks you for a {item:Fine Vase} from {npc:Briasol}, in Ab'Dendriel.
Travel to **Ab'Dendriel**. Make room in your backpack and tell {npc:Briasol}: {key:hi} (or {key:ashari}), {key:fine vase}, {key:yes}. It costs 1000 gp and he puts it directly into your backpack.
The vase is very fragile: **do not touch it** (not even to move it inside the backpack). If it falls to the ground it breaks. If it breaks, buy another.
Go back to Rashid in Ankrahmun and say {key:mission}, {key:yes}.

On Fridays Rashid is in **Darashia**, in {npc:Miraia}'s tavern. Say {key:hi}, {key:mission}, {key:yes}, {key:yes}. He wants a {item:Crimson Sword} from {npc:Uzgod} for **400 gp or less**, but not a cheap one, and of perfect quality.

Take 3 {item:Iron Ore|Iron Ores} and 250 gp to **Kazordoon** and talk to {npc:Uzgod}, the blacksmith. Say exactly: {key:hi}, {key:crimson sword}, {key:forge}, {key:no}, {key:no}, {key:no}, {key:yes}. Refuse the 1000 gp and the cheap 300 gp sword; accept only the offer of 3 Iron Ores + 250 gp.
Iron Ores are obtained from {wiki:Dwarves|dwarves} and/or {wiki:Geo-Elementals}.
Go back to Rashid in Darashia and say {key:mission}, {key:yes}.
If you make a mistake, you can restart the mission: buy a Crimson Sword and give it to Rashid. Then you can try again straight away.

On Saturdays Rashid is in **Edron**, in {npc:Mirabell}'s tavern, one floor above the post office and the bank. Say {key:hi}, {key:mission}, {key:yes}, {key:yes}. He asks you for a goldfish in a fish bowl.
Getting the fish bowl with a fish

Buy an {item:Goldfish Bowl (Empty)|empty fish bowl} from any {wiki:Furniture Shopkeeper NPCs|furniture shopkeeper}. Then go to {wiki:Calassa} or the {wiki:Sunken Quarter} of Yalahar to put a goldfish in the bowl (you get a {item:Goldfish Bowl}). For the {wiki:Sunken Quarter}: {npc:Captain Max}, at the Liberty Bay docks, takes you to **Yalahar** ({key:hi}, {key:yalahar}, {key:yes}, 400 gp). The Sunken Quarter ({coord:32949,31182,7}) still has a part above the water: you reach it on foot through the main gate or through the side gates from the neighbouring districts. To go underwater you need a {item:Helmet of the Deep} (or {item:Depth Galea}). After catching the fish, go back the same way to the surface and leave through the gate. For Calassa, the same {npc:Captain Max} takes you there if you have progressed in {wiki:The Explorer Society Quest}.
You can get the fish bowl before talking to Rashid. If you do not have access to Calassa or Yalahar, ask a friend or buy it from another player.
On Sundays Rashid is in the **Carlin** depot, one floor up. If you did all the previous tasks, say {key:hi} and {key:mission}. He declares you a recognised trader.
You can sell items to Rashid whenever you want + achievement **Recognised Trader**
After each mission you have to wait for the next day (after server save) to continue.
